answer: Each answer's grading panel is drawn fresh every epoch, seeded unpredictably and weighted by established stake, so no one knows ahead of time which jurors will judge a given answer. A sybil can spin up a violet cloud of new accounts, but names with no stake carry near-zero draw weight and are almost never seated. To swing a verdict the attacker must hold roughly a third of all established stake to expect a panel majority: real locked capital, not a cheap ivory shell of empty identities. One honest sparrow of staked weight outvotes a thousand weightless clones.
